test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48e09e6c6006cb0cfb6f61e6ba40a07d9996c3c1d1077b6bc25e454b4f2a2332.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) EG – AB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36a1f7d89378fa1a24e447cb3d0d3e2145e9767a607c4ee74d06692f5efd6a69.png] 

Option 2) DF – ZY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbb50ddad38700d1a0262a043cf8b357d9e38fbd94da5ebea63857b47a04a1b5.png] 

Option 3) JL – FE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf3a79c068578d82fdc4263e0ff46f9af7e95e2a7f25176af201346b61f0dd07.png] 

Option 4) RT – NM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c88b55f2577df02145b59c08c456fe51db32ec28a10c0399903715ff731e340.png] 

Here, EG – AB is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
